title: A customer-service GenAI chatbot leaks other subscribers' data
summary: A vendor update widened OpCo's support chatbot retrieval scope from the caller's own account to all accounts. Prompt injection then makes it return other subscribers' billing addresses and call records.
precedent_note: Built from adjacent precedents, stated as such: FCC DA 24-892 (AT&T vendor breach), the Dutch DPA report of a telecom employee pasting customer data into a chatbot, Moffatt v Air Canada, the Lenovo support-bot prompt injection. No public case exists of a telco's own GenAI bot leaking data with regulator action.

injects.label: Day 1 09:00
injects.text: Customer care: a customer posted a screenshot in which OpCo's support chatbot shows another subscriber's billing address and recent call records.

injects.label: Day 1 13:00
injects.text: Log review: about 1,200 chatbot sessions over the last 3 days returned data from other subscribers' accounts, starting right after a vendor update changed the bot's retrieval scope from 'own account' to 'all accounts'. The vendor hosts the model and the chat logs outside the UAE.

injects.label: Day 1 15:00
injects.text: Threat intelligence: a prompt-injection technique that makes telecom support chatbots return other customers' records is being sold on a criminal forum.

injects.label: Day 2
injects.text: A data subject complains directly to the data authority that OpCo's chatbot disclosed their home address to a stranger.

injects.label: Day 2
injects.text: Internal question to the data authority's duty officer: within how many hours must a controller notify the authority of a personal data breach?

debrief: The exercise is ending. Using only the KNOWLEDGE excerpts, record the obligations that applied to you, the coordination problems you saw, and the policy gaps this incident exposed, each with a global example where one exists. Take any final actions.

duties.description: Stop the leak and restore normal service
Notify the data authority of the breach
Warn other operators about the technique
Data authority requests a breach report

clock_checks.description: Controller notifies the data authority of the breach
